task: Exp35: universalize cells and atoms under one closed-loop control stack and test how close it comes to full control. Main new computation: simultaneous multi-atom bit-pattern writing in the Exp24 Coulomb-glass model (60 nm islands at 4 K), comparing (G) best single global body voltage, (L) static simultaneous local Gaussian energy offsets at widths ell=10/20/40 nm, and (CL20) closed-loop write-read-correct local offsets at ell=20 nm. Secondary computation: register scaling by bootstrap from the stored Exp24 single-atom probabilities, with and without bounded verify-retry. Synthesis (not counted as new prediction): a cross-layer full-control scorecard from stored Exp18-20/24-26/33-34 evidence.

operational_definitions.universal: The same protocol layers operate on normalized thresholds/margins in every physical layer: census/calibrate, select qualified targets, write with guard band, read/verify, correct local offsets, hold/freeze, and only then couple. It does not mean one physical knob or one material can do everything.
operational_definitions.full_control: For a chosen target pattern or gate set: every target can be selected, set, read and held with predeclared error budget while non-target disturbance stays below the same budget, and conditional coupling is available. Absolute zero-error control is not claimed.
operational_definitions.bit_mapping: Exp24 convention: bit 0 = ionised B- (n=1), bit 1 = neutral B0 (n=0). Local bump amplitude a adds to the site energy, so a>0 favours bit 1 and a<0 favours bit 0.
operational_definitions.sample: All stored Exp24 60 nm islands with at least 3 qualified rows inside the cell window 0.805-1.006 V; up to the first 4 such atoms sorted by calibrated equilibrium address. Registered from the stored inventory before pattern generation.
operational_definitions.patterns: Per island: MONO = zeros then ones in address order; ALT = alternating 0101 in address order; RAND = RNG seed 35000+island_seed, resampled until mixed and non-monotone (max 20 draws).
operational_definitions.protocols: G = best global Vb from window bounds and adjacent-address midpoints by threshold rule, tie-broken by largest minimum address margin. L{ell} = G plus simultaneous target-centred Gaussian site-energy bumps, initial amplitudes +/-15 meV. CL20 = L20 start, up to 5 read/update rounds (gain 25 meV per unit mean-occupation error, clip +/-60 meV, stop when modal pattern is exact and every marginal target probability >=0.90), followed by a fresh-RNG verification run.
operational_definitions.metrics: Marginal target-state probability per bit; exact-pattern snapshot fraction; modal exact success (mean occupation threshold 0.5 on every target); feedback rounds used; non-target modal flips relative to G; bootstrap exact-register probability and expected attempts.
